```{r setup, include=FALSE}
install.packages('pacman')

pacman::p_load(
  # data wrangling
  tidyverse, readxl, tidylog, data.table, janitor,
  
  
  # exploratory data analysis
  skimr, summarytools, psych, Hmisc,
  
  # machine learning
  class,
  FNN,
  caret,
  cluster,
  factoextra,
  NbClust,
  clvalid,
  e1071,
  
  
  # visualization
  ggpubr, plotly, factoextra, plotly, RColorBrewer, corrplot, GGally
)
```


```{r}
data_file <- file.choose()

df <- read_excel(data_file)

```

Inspect the data

```{r}
summary(df)

```
